meaning:
μετα-κινέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Deu.19:14 (סוּג hi.), Isa.54:10 (מוֹט), etc. ;]
trans.,
to move away, remove (ὅρια, Deu, l.with). Mid., to remove oneself, remove, shift: metaphorically, ἀπὸ τ. ἐλπίδος, Col.1:23.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being…
